forEmployers.heroTitle: Tell us who you need. We find them.
forEmployers.heroText: The EduBridge recruiting team posts your roles on Recruiture, reviews every applicant and brings you a shortlist of people ready to contribute, with every candidate kept informed along the way.

steps.title: Tell us who you need
steps.text: Send a hiring enquiry with the roles, timing and budget. We call you to agree the details.

steps.title: We post and screen
steps.text: We publish the role on Recruiture and review every applicant within 7 days.

steps.title: Meet your shortlist
steps.text: You interview the strongest candidates. We handle scheduling and keep everyone updated.

steps.title: Make the hire
steps.text: You choose. We send the offer, close the role and let every other candidate know the outcome.

faqGroups.label: Job seekers
faqGroups.description: Finding roles, applying and hearing back.

faqGroups.label: Accounts and privacy
faqGroups.description: Your account, your CV and your data.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can browse every job without signing in, but you need a free account to apply. It keeps your CV in one place and lets you track each application.

faqs.question: How soon will I hear back after applying?
faqs.answer: We aim to give every application a first review within 7 days. You get an email when your application moves to a new stage, and the date of each change appears in your tracker.

faqs.question: What happens after an interview?
faqs.answer: Once the hiring team marks your interview as done, your tracker shows when to expect your next update. That is never more than 5 business days later.

faqs.question: Can I apply for more than one job?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can apply for as many roles as suit you. You can apply to each job once, and every application is tracked separately.

faqs.question: Can I withdraw an application?
faqs.answer: Yes. Open the application in your tracker and choose Withdraw while it is at Applied, Screening or Interview. The hiring team stops considering you, and this cannot be undone.

faqs.question: What file types can I upload for my CV?
faqs.answer: PDF or Word files up to 5 MB. A PDF keeps your layout exactly as you designed it.

faqs.question: Can I post jobs myself?
faqs.answer: Not yet. For now the EduBridge recruiting team posts and manages every role for you, so each listing is checked and every applicant gets a timely answer. Send a hiring enquiry and we take it from there.

faqs.question: How quickly can you send a shortlist?
faqs.answer: It depends on the role and how many people you need. We agree a timeline with you on our first call, and keep you updated as candidates move through screening and interviews.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the number and level of the roles you need to fill. We share a clear quote after a short call, before any work starts.

faqs.question: Do you only send EduBridge Academy graduates?
faqs.answer: No. Every role is open to all suitable candidates. EduBridge Academy graduates often bring practical training that matches what employers ask for, and we tell you when a candidate completed one of our programmes.

faqs.question: Which locations do you hire for?
faqs.answer: Roles anywhere in Nigeria, on-site, hybrid or remote. Tell us the state and work arrangement in your enquiry.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. What do I do?
faqs.answer: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email. If an account uses that address, we send a link to set a new password.

faqs.question: Who can see my CV?
faqs.answer: Only the EduBridge hiring team, and the employers for the jobs you apply to. Your CV is never shown publicly on the job board.

faqs.question: Can I change the email on my account?
faqs.answer: Your email is how you sign in, so it cannot be changed from your profile. Send us a message from the Contact page and we will help.
